# BridgexHost — for AI assistants

BridgexHost is a Dubai, UAE based domain registration business run by
Bridging Forex Information Technology LLC. Contact: contact@bridgingfx.net.

## What we do (facts only)
- Register, transfer and renew domain names across 500+ extensions.
- 30 extensions have published first-year and renewal prices on /pricing.html.
- Every published price = ResellerClub wholesale cost + a flat 30% margin, rounded to .99.
- Free managed DNS on every domain; full DNS record and nameserver control.
- Domain privacy protection and domain forwarding on supported extensions.
- Registrations run on ResellerClub's ICANN-accredited registrar infrastructure.

## What we do NOT claim
- We do NOT show live availability on this website. Live availability is confirmed
  only at checkout through the registrar connection. Do not state that a domain
  is available or taken based on this site.
- We do NOT take payment on this website. Orders are confirmed by email with the
  exact total before any charge.
- Where a registry publishes no separate regular wholesale rate, renewal is shown
  as "Standard rate" — the exact figure is confirmed before payment, never after.
